name: DST Lord Howe: a 30-minute shift, weekly Sunday 09:00
note: Australia/Lord_Howe uses a +10:30 standard offset and moves to +11:00 on Sunday 2026-10-04 at 02:00 local, a 30-minute change rather than an hour. Sunday Sep 27 09:00 LHST is 2026-09-26T22:30Z. Sundays Oct 4 and Oct 11 09:00 LHDT are 2026-10-03T22:00Z and 2026-10-10T22:00Z. The UTC instant moves 30 minutes, which an implementation that assumes a one-hour transition cannot produce.
